description: A default object value without a required attribute is an error
notes: The spec's conversion rules convert {} to object({b = string}) by populating b with null (spec.md#collection-and-structural-type-conversions), which would make {} a valid default, while the README says a missing object attribute would typically result in an error. hashicorp/hcl converts each default value to its attribute's type when it reads the type (getType in ext/typeexpr/get_type.go), and go-cty's object conversion requires every attribute that isn't optional (conversionObjectToObject in cty/convert/conversion_object.go).
reference_error: This default value is not compatible with the attribute's type constraint
